messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered: HIGH - gpu-pool-provisioning in prod-east-1. Symptom: sustained queue growth for gpu-serving pods, autoscaler unable to add nodes. Severity: P1. See /incidents/3969002468.
oncall-eng: I'm on it. Seeing queue length spike on the inference queue (> 3x baseline) and a ton of Pending pods with nodeSelector=gpu. kubectl shows pods Pending with FailedScheduling: 0/0 nodes are available: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
infra-sre: grabbing autoscaler logs now. Preliminary: cluster-autoscaler attempted to create new nodegroup but API returned 403 for iam:PassRole on the node-launch role. Launch template exists but CA retries with different version.
ops-lead: Customer impact: several production customers experiencing increased tail latency and throttling; support is reporting ~8% erroring requests and slow responses. Support-lead, please confirm customer list.
support-lead: Confirmed: Customers A and B on prod-east-1 are reporting >500ms extra latencies and 429s for spike-heavy endpoints. Filing outage notice to status page after we have mitigation ETA.
ml-serving: Reprioritizing smaller batch sizes and temporarily reducing max-concurrency for serving endpoints to shed load. Starting graceful fallback to CPU replicas for low-priority models.
oncall-eng: autoscaler stdout: 
```
I0503 15:12:01.123456 main.go:123] ScaleUp: NoCandidatePoolsFound - no suitable node group matched request (launch template mismatch)
E0503 15:12:02.234567 aws_manager.go:456] CreateNodeGroup API error: UnauthorizedOperation: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/ca-role is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/gpu-node-role
```
infra-sre: That 403 means CA can't assume the instance profile role; could be a recent policy drift from rollout. Checking commit history for launch template and nodegroup role changes.
eng-manager: Any immediate manual mitigation we can do to get extra GPUs online?
ops-lead: Options: 1) manual scale-up of an existing nodegroup if role works; 2) create temporary nodegroup using a known-good launch template and explicitly set instanceProfile; 3) temporarily relax the autoscaler RBAC/policies (risky). Prefer 2 for fastest safe option.
infra-sre: I'm going to create a temp nodegroup with the old working launch template version and attach the existing gpu-node-role. Will mark as taint-free so pods can schedule. Executing: 
```
aws eks create-nodegroup --cluster-name prod-east-1 --nodegroup-name temp-gpu-burst-123 --node-role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/gpu-node-role --launch-template name=redwood-gpu-lt,version=42 --scaling-config minSize=0,maxSize=8,desiredSize=2
```
oncall-eng: Also flipping autoscaler logs to debug: `kubectl -n kube-system logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler --tail=200` and `kubectl get events -A | grep -i autoscaler`
support-lead: Opening a customer advisory draft. Will not post until mitigation confirms improvement.
infra-sre: create-nodegroup call returned 201 Accepted. CloudFormation stack in progress. If this succeeds, we'll label nodes with taint:gpu=true:NoSchedule? Wait - we want scheduling to succeed, so do NOT apply taint. Temporary nodegroup will be untainted.
ml-serving: Steering non-critical traffic to CPU pool. Applying rate limit in the router: `routectl update --service inference --max-qps 1500`
oncall-eng: Pods starting on temp nodes: `kubectl get pods -A | grep Pending` shows many Pending decreasing to near zero over 2 minutes. Queue length trending down.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation in progress. Temporary nodegroup creation in flight and traffic shaping applied. No customer-facing announcement yet.
ops-lead: Important: we still need to fix CA role so autoscaler can create nodegroups automatically. Infra-sre, can you confirm root cause and a remediation plan?
infra-sre: Root cause: a recent infra rollout (2026-04-28) changed the GPU nodegroup's launch template to reference a new instance profile name `gpu-node-role-v2`. The cluster-autoscaler's IAM role (assumed-role/ca-role) wasn't updated with iam:PassRole permission for the new role ARN. PR to update the policy is queued but not deployed. Remediation plan: 1) update CA role to allow PassRole for both v1 and v2 role ARNs (hotfix). 2) revert launch template to v1 or update CA policy; 3) add integration test to detect PassRole mismatches. I'm pushing the hotfix now.
eng-manager: Please prioritize the hotfix. Timeboxed 15m. If not done, we'll keep temp nodegroup workaround and schedule a deploy window.
infra-sre: Patching IAM policy: `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name ca-role --policy-name allow-passrole-gpu --policy-document file://ca-passrole-hotfix.json` (policy added for both ARNs). Applying.
oncall-eng: After patch, triggered autoscaler reconcile. Observing CA attempts to create nodegroup and now gets 200.
incident-bot: Update: autoscaler created new nodegroup `sg-autoscale-2026-05-03` successfully. Pods drained onto new GPU nodes. Queue backlog cleared to baseline.
support-lead: Starting to inform affected customers (A,B) with mitigation summary and ETA to full recovery. Draft: "We experienced capacity provisioning delays due to an internal autoscaler permission mismatch. We applied an emergency fix and added temporary capacity; traffic restored. We will follow up with root cause and permanent fix."
product-ops: Any risk of residual taints or scheduling mislabels? Need to audit node labels and taints.
infra-sre: Running audit: `kubectl get nodes -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, taints:.spec.taints, labels:.metadata.labels}'` All GPU nodes have expected labels and no stray taints.
oncall-eng: Handing off to infra-sre for postmortem and cleanup. I'll keep the incident open for 1h for monitoring.
infra-sre: Postmortem items created: (1) Patch CA role PR merged and will be deployed to prod in the next infra rollout, (2) add CI check for iam:PassRole coverage, (3) backfill monitoring alert for CA 403/UnauthorizedOperation, (4) document temp nodegroup runbook.
ops-lead: Great. Support-lead, please escalate follow-ups with customers and mark incident as resolved once latency metrics are stable for 30m.
support-lead: Will monitor. Notifying customers now.
eng-manager: Thanks team. Good quick mitigation. Please add timeline and what went well/failed in the postmortem doc.
incident-bot: Incident P1 mitigated. Next update due in 30m for closure.
summary: GPU capacity exhaustion in prod-east-1 due to autoscaler inability to PassRole for new launch template role; temporary nodegroup created, hotfix IAM policy applied, queues cleared and customers being notified.
